2024-diary-of-a-pilgrimage.creator: Jerome K. Jerome
2024-diary-of-a-pilgrimage.description: A book by Jerome K. Jerome. not want to swamp you with knowledge. I wish to lead you gradually. When you have learnt this book, you can come again, and I will tell you some more. I should only be defeating my own object did I, by making you think too much at first, give you a perhaps, lasting dislike to the exercise.

apollonius-argonautica-seaton.description: Apollonius of Rhodes' Argonautica: Jason and the Argonauts' quest for the Golden Fleece. R. C. Seaton translation via Project Gutenberg.

arxiv-2012-14402.title: Deep Neural Models for color discrimination and color constancy
arxiv-2012-14402.creator: Flachot, Akbarinia, Schütt, Fleming, Wichmann, Gegenfurtner
arxiv-2012-14402.description: Abstract Color constancy is our ability to perceive constant colors across varying illuminations. Here, we trained deep neural networks to be color constant and evaluated their performance with varying cues. Inputs to the networks consisted of the cone excitations in 3D-rendered images of 2115 different 3D-shapes, with spectral reflectances of 1600 different Munsell chips, illuminated under 278 different natural illuminations.

arxiv-2107-04695.title: L2M: Practical posterior Laplace approximation with optimization-driven second moment estimation
arxiv-2107-04695.creator: Christian S. Perone, Roberto Pereira Silveira, Thomas Paula
arxiv-2107-04695.description: Abstract Uncertainty quantification for deep neural networks has recently evolved through many techniques. In this work, we revisit Laplace approximation, a classical approach for posterior approximation that is computationally attractive. However, instead of computing the curvature matrix, we show that, under some regularity conditions, the Laplace approximation can be easily constructed using the gradient second moment.

arxiv-2108-05800.title: On Liquidity Mining for Uniswap v3
arxiv-2108-05800.creator: Jimmy Yin, Mac Ren
arxiv-2108-05800.description: Abstract . The recently proposed Uniswap v3 replaces the fungible liquidity provider token (LP token) into non-fungible ones, making the design for liquidity mining more difficult. In this paper, we propose a flexible liquidity mining scheme that realizes the overall liquidity distribution through the fine control of local rewards.

arxiv-2204-10070.title: Multi-UAV trajectory planning for 3D visual inspection of complex structures Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2204-10070.creator: Stefan Ivić, Bojan Crnković, Luka Grbčić, Lea Matleković
arxiv-2204-10070.description: Abstract The application of autonomous UAVs to infrastructure inspection tasks provides benefits in terms of operation time reduction, safety, and cost-effectiveness. This paper presents trajectory planning for three-dimensional autonomous multi-UAV volume coverage and visual inspection of infrastructure based on the Heat Equation Driven Area Coverage (HEDAC) algorithm.

arxiv-2407-21071.title: Graded lithium-ion battery pouch cells to homogenise current distributions and reduce lithium plating
arxiv-2407-21071.creator: R. Drummond, E. C. Tredenick, T. L. Kirk, M. Forghani, P. S. Grant, S. R. Duncan
arxiv-2407-21071.description: Abstract Spatial distributions in current, temperature, state-of-charge and degradation across the plane of large format lithium-ion battery pouch cells can significantly impact their performance, especially at high C-rates. In this paper, a method to smooth out these spatial distributions by grading the electrode microstructure in-the-plane is proposed.

arxiv-2503-09876.title: A New Circle Theorem for Two Dimensional Ising Spin Glasses
arxiv-2503-09876.creator: Chaoming Song
arxiv-2503-09876.description: Abstract The Lee-Yang circle theorem revolutionized our understanding of phase transitions in ferromagnetic systems by showing that the complex zeros of partition functions lie on the unit circle, with criticality arising as these zeros approach the real axis in the thermodynamic limit.

arxiv-2505-11417.title: EdgeWisePersona: A Dataset for On-Device User Profiling from Natural Language Interactions
arxiv-2505-11417.creator: Patryk Bartkowiak, Michal Podstawski
arxiv-2505-11417.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Patryk Bartkowiak, Michal Podstawski. This paper introduces a novel dataset and evaluation benchmark designed to assess and improve small language models deployable on edge devices, with a focus on user profiling from multi-session natural language interactions in smart home environments. At the core of the dataset are structured user profiles, each defined by a set of routines - context-triggered, repeatable patterns of behavior that govern how users interact with their home systems.

arxiv-2507-15312.title: Idefix-Closed Languages and Their Application in Contextual Grammars
arxiv-2507-15312.creator: Marvin Ködding, Bianca Truthe
arxiv-2507-15312.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marvin Ködding, Bianca Truthe. In this paper, we continue the research on the power of contextual grammars with selection languages from subfamilies of the family of regular languages. We investigate infix-, prefix-, and suffix-closed languages (referred to as idefix-closed languages) and compare such language families to some other subregular families of languages (finite, monoidal, nilpotent, combinational, (symmetric) definite, ordered, non-counting, power-separating, commutative, circular, union-free, star, and comet languages).

Esta revisão integrativa...

pmc-11333585.title: Simulation of CRISPR-Cas9 editing on evolving barcode and accuracy of lineage tracing
pmc-11333585.creator: Fengshuo Liu, Xiang Zhang, Yipeng Yang
pmc-11333585.description: We designed a simulation program that mimics the CRISPR-Cas9 editing on evolving barcode and double strand break repair procedure along with cell divisions. Emerging barcode mutations tend to build upon previously existing mutations, occurring sequentially with each generation. This process results in a unique mutation profile in each cell.

pmc-11351264.title: Molecular Hydrogen and Extracorporeal Gas Exchange: A Match Made in Heaven? An In Vitro Pilot Study
pmc-11351264.creator: Foivos Leonidas Mouzakis, Flutura Hima, Ali Kashefi, Johannes Greven, Lothar Rink, Emiel P. C. van der Vorst, Joachim Jankowski, Khosrow Mottaghy, Jan Spillner
pmc-11351264.description: Extracorporeal circulation (ECC) is frequently implemented in a vast array of modalities such as hemodialysis, cardiopulmonary bypass, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO), and others. Patients receiving any such therapy are frequently encumbered with chronic inflammation, which is inherently accompanied by oxidative stress. However, ECC treatments themselves are also responsible for sustaining or promoting inflammation.

pmc-11489259.title: Identification of genetic association between mitochondrial dysfunction and knee osteoarthritis through integrating multi-omics: a summary data-based Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11489259.creator: Jiale Xie, Rui Ma, Xin Xu, Mingyi Yang, Hui Yu, Xianjie Wan, Ke Xu, Junfei Guo, Peng Xu
pmc-11489259.description: ObjectiveAssociation between mitochondrial dysfunction and osteoarthritis (OA) has been consistently investigated, yet their genetic association remains obscure. In this study, mitochondrial-related genes were used as instrumental variables to proxy for mitochondrial dysfunction, and summary data of knee OA (KOA) were used as outcome to examine their genetic association.MethodsWe obtained 1136 mitochondrial-related genes from the human MitoCarta3.0 database.

pmc-12566858.title: The Athlete Gut Microbiome: A Narrative Review of Multi-Omics Insights and Next-Generation Probiotic Strategies
pmc-12566858.creator: Zhiwei Li, Youqiang Li, Yufei Wang, Jinjin Chen, Yilan Liu, Stefano Guandalini
pmc-12566858.description: The gut microbiome plays a pivotal role in athletic health and performance by influencing metabolism, immunity, gastrointestinal integrity, and recovery. Advances in high-throughput sequencing and integrative multi-omics approaches have provided unprecedented insights into how microbial communities adapt to the physiological demands of training and competition.

pmc-12590741.title: Active and resolved HCV infections among people with new HIV-1 diagnoses in Germany, 2009–2019
pmc-12590741.creator: Daniel Ivanusic, Amare Eshetu, Hussein Al-Shehabi, Andrea Hauser, Patrycja Klink, Daniel Schmidt, Uwe Koppe, Barbara Gunsenheimer-Bartmeyer, Viviane Bremer, Norbert Bannert
pmc-12590741.description: BackgroundHIV and HCV share similar routes of infection. Individuals carrying both viruses experience a faster progression of the liver disease. We have analyzed people with new HIV-1 diagnoses in Germany for active or resolved HCV infection for over ten years. The time period covers the introduction of direct acting antivirals (DAA), a paradigmatic shift in HCV therapy.

pmc-12715061.title: On the origin of the reward function: Exploring the role of conditioned reinforcement and social learning
pmc-12715061.creator: Francesco Rigoli
pmc-12715061.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Influential cognitive science theories postulate that decision-making is based on treating expected outcomes as incentives according to a reward function. Yet a systematic analysis of the learning processes that determine the reward function remains to be carried out. The paper fills this gap by examining the contribution of two fundamental learning processes: conditioned reinforcement, occurring either via direct or via vicarious experience, and imitative incentive learning, at play when an agent appropriates the incentives sought by another individual.

pmc-13214240.title: Laparoscopic Suitcase Technique for lateral incisional hernias enables fully laparoscopic fascial closure: a retrospective comparative study
pmc-13214240.creator: Kryspin Mitura, Krystian Kisielewski, Michal Romanczuk, Mitura Bernard, Malgorzata Sawicka, Laura Kacprzak, Piotr Niecikowski
pmc-13214240.description: BackgroundLateral incisional hernias represent a distinct subset of abdominal wall defects and pose specific challenges in minimally invasive surgery due to unfavorable force vectors and the absence of a central anchoring structure. Hybrid approaches combining laparoscopic dissection with open fascial closure can facilitate repair but partially negate the benefits of minimally invasive surgery.

pmc-13306583.title: Fractional Viscoelastic Modeling of Creep and Stress Relaxation Behaviors in Polymer-Based Energetic Materials
pmc-13306583.creator: Duo Gao, Wei Tang, Long Zhao, Hongwei Yuan
pmc-13306583.description: This study compares low-parameter fractional viscoelastic models for the unified characterization and extrapolation of creep and stress relaxation behaviors in polymer-based energetic materials, including polymer-bonded explosives (PBXs) and solid propellants. Fourteen candidate models composed of springs and spring-pot elements were considered under controlled parameter complexity.

pmc-13443888.title: Trend term and noise removal method for blasting vibration signals based on Fourier decomposition
pmc-13443888.creator: Yan Zhao, Lujun Yin, Wenzhe Zhang, Jiaxing Tao, He Wang, Ziyi Yun
pmc-13443888.description: The trend term and noise in blasting vibration signals severely affect the accuracy of analysis. However, existing adaptive decomposition methods still have limitations in removing these trend and noise components. This study develops a Fourier decomposition–based (FDM) preprocessing approach for blasting vibration signals by optimizing key parameters, including the cross-correlation threshold, the ultra-low-frequency energy threshold, and the decomposition search path.

pmc-7619378.title: Urban survival, population dynamics and historical transitions in Thessaloniki (316 BC-AD 1500)
pmc-7619378.creator: Asterios Aidonis, Christina Kakasa, Elissavet Ganiatsou, Panagiota Bantavanou, Soultana Protopsalti, Stavroula Tzevreni, Stela Vasileiadou, Krino Konstantinidou, Christina Papageorgopoulou
pmc-7619378.description: Cities have historically endured profound challenges while sustaining their populations through adaptive structures and functions. Understanding contemporary urbanization requires situating it within these long-term historical trajectories. This study examines the demographic consequences of historical transitions in Thessaloniki over 1,800 years, based on 846 individuals recovered from peri-urban and intramural cemeteries.
